from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the necessary financial metrics for one company's report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock code of the company, if available")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2025 年第一季度")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders. Negative values indicate a loss.")
    net_cash_flow_from_operating_activities: float = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities. Positive values indicate a positive flow.")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency of the financial figures, e.g., CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: List[CompanyFinancialRecord]
